scenicChapters.title: Signal de Botrange → La Roche en Ardenne
scenicChapters.narrative: 51 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
